sloka: स्तुवन्नृपतिशार्धूलं प्रविवेश निवेशनम् ।तं तु पूर्वोदितं वृद्धं द्वारस्था राजसम्मतम् ॥२-१४-४४॥
transliteration: stuvannṛpatiśārdhūlaṁ praviveśa niveśanam ।taṁ tu pūrvoditaṁ vṛddhaṁ dvārasthā rājasammatam ॥2-14-44॥

translations.english: The doorkeepers, beloved wellwishers of the king, did not detain aged Sumantra who was liked by the king and who had arrived early.
